description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
The Hollow Sentinel enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Grinding Station and The Hollow Sentinel, untapping Throne of Geth.
Repeat.
